prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.6*Z0*Z4 (a single interaction term between the two most distant qubits). gamma = 0.5. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — qubits 0 and 4 are the two endpoints, maximum distance apart, so routing overhead is expected. Any correct implementation of the phase term is accepted. No measurement.
